findings.label: removePanelist index race
findings.issue: removePanelist reads the document to validate the index, then issues $unset/$pull in separate updates; a concurrent panelist edit between the read and the write can shift indices and remove the wrong entry (or no-op on an out-of-range index).
findings.action: Accept the race for a low-traffic admin endpoint, or collapse the read, bounds-check, and removal into a single atomic update that guards on the current array length.

findings.label: No tests for panelist endpoints
findings.issue: The three routes and service methods have no specs, and the events module has no test harness at all.
findings.action: Add coverage for the append/replace/remove happy paths, the NotFoundException branch, and the BadRequestException bounds branch (including index === panelists.length) when the module gains a test suite.
